title: Calibrate triage and tenant rules so all e2e scenarios pass; add Kestrel commercial auto
story: As an insurer evaluator I want every e2e scenario to pass for both demo tenants (ADR-003), and commercial auto available for Kestrel Point (REQ-24).
acceptance: node --test --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/e2e/scenarios.test.mjs tests/e2e/harness.test.mjs passes with 0 failures for both aurelia-mutual and kestrel-point (baseline: 54 failing subtests in org/quality-baseline.txt)

Triage bands follow 0-24 minor, 25-49 moderate, 50-74 major, 75-100 severe; auto_rear_end_injury yields moderate and home_water_small yields minor, or the scenario expectation is changed with a one-line ADR-003 rationale comment
Aurelia fast-tracks glass-only and home water under $2,500 via STP rules in tenants/aurelia-mutual.json

Rules engine falls back to the tenant default queue when a rule names no queue; the harness temp tenant e2e-demo no longer routes to an undefined queue; a unit test in tests/unit/rules/ covers the fallback

tenants/kestrel-point.json has a commercial_auto question set (fleet/unit number, driver employment status, DOT number, cargo, permissive use) and rules routing to a commercial queue that never fast-track; commercial_auto_fleet_collision scenario passes
Result lists root cause per failure category (severity bands, STP rules, undefined queue, other) for defect records
Only synthetic data; no files written outside listed paths
brief: Start by running tests/e2e/scenarios.test.mjs and harness.test.mjs and grouping the 54 failing subtests by cause; read ADR-003 for the rule on tuning weights versus changing expectations. Expect four categories. (1) Severity bands off by about one band: inspect weights and cut-offs in src/modules/triage/ (score to band mapping must be 0-24/25-49/50-74/75-100); adjust weights or the injury/water factors, then re-run unit tests in tests/unit/triage/ and update them only if they encode the wrong values. Prefer fixing the weights over editing scenario expectations; edit an expectation only when the scenario is arguably wrong and add a one-line rationale. (2) Aurelia STP: add or fix rules in tenants/aurelia-mutual.json so glass-only auto claims and homeowners water damage with estimate under 2500 are fast-tracked; check the rule condition field names against the rules module and tenants/README.md. (3) Harness temp tenant e2e-demo (tests/e2e/harness.mjs) routes to an undefined queue: make src/modules/rules/ fall back to the tenant default queue when a matched rule has no queue, and make sure the harness tenant defines a default queue; add a unit test. (4) Commercial auto for Kestrel: add the commercial_auto question set and rules (commercial queue, fastTrack never true, including overriding any generic STP rule) in tenants/kestrel-point.json, extend tests/unit/config/demo-tenants.test.mjs for validation, and add or enable the commercial_auto_fleet_collision scenario in tests/e2e/scenarios.test.mjs. Pitfalls: other teams are editing other folders at once, so use only tenant-bound ctx APIs and do not touch package.json or src outside triage/rules; run only your own tests; do not commit. Post progress and any contract-change request to the integration/architecture hubs with --ticket S2-ITG-01.
